France withdraws support for FIFA President Gianni Infantino's re-election bid

The French Football Federation (FFF) has withdrawn its support for FIFA President Gianni Infantino's bid for re-election in March 2027. The decision was made during a meeting of the FFF's executive committee on Thursday. Infantino has faced criticism for a failed commercial partnership project. Separately, FIFA has been accused of not investigating Infantino ally Samuel Eto'o.
